name: Zap Rail
summary: A tab menu whose underline leaps to the next item as a crackling bolt of electricity
about: A website menu or tab row with a glowing underline. When you point at or pick another item, the underline snaps away, a jagged bolt arcs across the menu, flickers and lands with sparks, the item it hits gets a little electric jolt, and the line flashes back on under it. Good for product sites, docs and app tabs that want a little energy.
how: Point at a menu item to preview the jump, or click it, or use the arrow keys, Home and End.
The underline shrinks away, the logo flickers and a lightning bolt draws itself from the old item to the new one.
The bolt re-forms twice like real lightning, sparks fly where it lands and that item's icon and label jolt with a glow.
Clicking selects the tab and the panel's cards flip up one by one; moving the pointer away sends the spark back to the selected tab.
